plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: Clouds of airy, blush-white blossoms wrap every branch before the leaves appear. Around the Tidal Basin the trees turn the waterfront into a pale pink haze that reflects in the still water.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to early April, with peak bloom most often falling between the last week of March and the first week of April
plants.location: Washington, D.C., USA (Tidal Basin and National Mall)
plants.funFact: The first Yoshino trees were a gift from Tokyo to Washington in 1912. Peak bloom is officially declared when 70% of the Yoshino blossoms are open.

plants.name: Eschscholzia californica
plants.description: Silky, cup-shaped flowers glow like spilled marmalade across hillsides and roadsides. The petals open in full sun and fold shut on cloudy days and at dusk.
plants.bloomingSeason: Spring, with March to May the strongest bloom period
plants.location: California, USA, in grasslands, foothills and open slopes
plants.funFact: California poppy is the state flower of California. Despite its brilliant color, it belongs to the poppy family and its finely cut, blue-green foliage is almost as distinctive as its flowers.

plants.name: Amaryllis belladonna
plants.description: Leafless stems shoot up from the dry ground, each topped with a cluster of fragrant, trumpet-shaped pink blooms. They appear when the summer heat starts to fade, long after the foliage has died back.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late summer to autumn, flowering around March in the Southern Hemisphere
plants.location: Southwestern Cape, South Africa, where it is native
plants.funFact: Its common name comes from its habit of flowering in March in the Southern Hemisphere. It is also called the naked lady, because the flowers appear on bare stalks without leaves.

plants.name: Magnolia campbellii
plants.description: Enormous, goblet-shaped flowers open on bare branches high in the Himalayan forest. Their pink petals look like tropical water lilies lifted into the treetops.
plants.location: Eastern Himalaya, including Bhutan, Nepal and northeast India, and adjoining parts of China
plants.funFact: Seedlings can take decades to flower for the first time. This is one reason the tree's showy blooms are so prized by gardeners and plant collectors.
